name: showing-files-in-chat
title_zh: 聊天页里塞不进本地图，它给你一条能点的出路
tagline_zh: 你生成的图、录的屏、导出的 PDF 明明在磁盘上，用户却只能干瞪眼——它把「看不了」变成「点开即达」。
tagline_en: Your generated images, screen recordings, PDFs sit on disk but users can't see them. This turns dead ends into.
desc_en: How to actually show or hand off a local image/video/document to the user from within the chat -- the chat page itself cannot embed arbitrary local files inline. Use this whenever you need to display, open, or hand the user a file that isn't one of your own shipped reference photos.
why_zh: 不靠内嵌幻想，认账聊天页的边界，用文件协议或临时托管把本地资产变成用户真能打开的入口。
why_en: It admits the chat page can't embed local files, then bridges the gap with file:// or temporary hosting—honest, practical, and.
limit_zh: 只解决「把已有本地文件递给用户」这一步；不负责生成、转码或美化文件本身。若目标平台禁外部链接或 file:// 协议。
limit_en: Only hands off existing local files; no generation, transcoding, or beautification. If the platform blocks file:// or external links, the handoff.
title_en: Hand off local files from chat with a clickable path
